items.h: Makes two short field goals in loss
items.s: Loop went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made his only PAT during Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Bengals. Loop made an extra point in the first quarter and field goals from 34 and 24 yards in the second quarter before he and the rest of the Ravens went scoreless in the second half. The kicker has now gone 12-for-15 on field-goal tries while converting all 17 of his PATs over the first seven contests during the 2026 campaign.

items.h: Tyler Loop perfect in Week 7
items.s: Tyler Loop connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 1-of-1 extra point in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals. Loop connected on field goals from 24 and 34 yards out to provide the Ravens a 13-0 halftime lead. The second-year kicker could be a stronger option for fantasy managers with the return of Lamar Jackson expected in Week 8.

items.h: Tyler Loop a Good Kicking Option Boosted By Potential QB Return
items.s: Baltimore Ravens kicker Tyler Loop is a solid fantasy kicking option in Week 7 against the Cincinnati Bengals. They have allowed double-digit fantasy points to kickers in three out of five games. The Miami Dolphins and Houston Texans kickers were the only two not to reach double digits, but one plays for arguably the worst offense in the NFL, while the other could've had a much bigger fantasy day if he didn't miss a 58-yard field goal. Tyler Loop has been decent fantasy-wise this season, but that is understandable given the injuries the Ravens have sustained on offense. With Ja'Kobi Lane ramping up playtime and Lamar Jackson potentially returning after missing the last two weeks, the…

items.h: Misses kick versus Browns
items.s: Loop converted one his two field-goal attempts and his lone extra-point try during Baltimore's loss to Cleveland on Sunday. Loop missed a 49-yard field goal in the fourth quarter, which ended up being the difference in the three-point loss. This was his first missed kick of the season, and he will look to bounce back next week versus the Bengals.

items.h: Tyler Loop scores four points in Week 6 loss
items.s: Baltimore Ravens kicker Tyler Loop made one of his two field goal attempts and converted his lone PAT in a Week 6 loss against the Cleveland Browns. Loop left three points on the board in what was ultimately a three-point loss, though Cleveland missed a field goal as well. His miss was a 49-yarder early in the fourth quarter. He has struggled from that range, with all three misses this season coming between 40 and 49 yards.

items.h: Tyler Loop is a Solid Start Again in Week 6
items.s: Baltimore Ravens kicker Tyler Loop looks to continue his reliability as the Ravens travel to Cleveland in Week 6 to take on the Browns. Last week against the Atlanta Falcons, Loop made all three field goals, including two from 51 yards out. He also made one extra point in overtime. So far this season, Loop is perfect beyond 50 yards, making all five long-range attempts. This AFC North matchup has one of the week's lowest over/unders, and points probably will be hard to come by. Also, backup quarterback Tyler Huntley will get the nod again this week after Lamar Jackson (ankle) was ruled out Friday afternoon. For these reasons, the Ravens may opt to rely on Loop's leg to put points on the…

items.h: Converts all four kicks vs. Atlanta
items.s: Loop went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point try during the Ravens' 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons on Sunday. All three of Loop's made field goals came in the first half, the last two of which both came from 51 yards. It was his first game of the season of at least three field goals, and his five makes from 50-plus yards are tied for second-most in the NFL behind Spencer Shrader (six). Loop is 9-for-11 on field-goal attempts and 15-for-15 on PATs through five regular-season games, and the Ravens will hit the road for a Week 6 AFC North clash against the Browns on Oct. 18.

items.h: Tyler Loop hits three field goals in Sunday's win
items.s: Tyler Loop made all three of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT in Sunday night's 30-23 win over the Falcons. Loop is now 9-of-11 on field goals with a long of 64 yards through five games. He's also made 15-of-15 PATs. The second-year pro impressed as a rookie, and he's further cemented himself as a reliable kicker so far this season.

items.h: Tyler Loop is a Mid-Tier Kicking Option in Week 5
items.s: Baltimore Ravens kicker Tyler Loop drilled a 64-yard field goal and made all three extra-point attempts against the Tennessee Titans in Week 4. Loop did miss a 40-yard field goal wide left late in the fourth quarter, but the hold on that attempt may have been an issue. Loop should benefit from the controlled environment inside Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta against the Falcons in Week 5, with the second-year kicker making six of seven field goals and all six extra points across his young career playing indoors. However, the Ravens offense gets a slight downgrade with two-time MVP quarterback Lamar Jackson (ankle) missing Week 5 due to injury. Veteran backup quarterback Tyler Huntley will…

items.h: Makes 64-yard field goal
items.s: Loop went 1-for-2 on field-goal tries and made all three of his PATs during Sunday's 24-18 win over Tennessee. Loop converted a career-long 64-yard field goal as time expired in the first half, giving Baltimore a 24-7 lead heading into the break. The kicker later missed a 40-yard attempt wide left in the fourth quarter, marking his second field-goal miss of the year. Loop has gone 6-for-8 on field-goal tries, including 4-for-4 from 50-plus yards, over the first four contests in his sophomore campaign with the Ravens.

items.h: Loop made both field-goal tries, including a 56-yard game-winning kick as time expired, and all four extra-point attempts in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Cowboys.
items.s: Loop's kick flew just inside the left upright to lift the Ravens to victory. The kicker has missed just once in 2026 so far. As long as the Ravens keep scoring, the 2025 sixth-round pick will remain a strong fantasy play.

items.h: Loop went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 on PATs in Sunday's 24-17 loss to the Saints.
items.s: Loop had his first field-goal try from 49 yards blocked in the second quarter before converting from 49 yards in the third quarter. It was a step back from Loop's Week 1 in which he made all seven kicks. He'll be in line for a big rebound game next Sunday in a potential shootout under the dome at AT&T Stadium against the Cowboys.

items.h: Loop made both of his field-goal attempts and all five PATs in Sunday's 41-23 win over the Colts.
items.s: After a rough preseason, Loop kept his job as the Ravens' kicker despite the team's addition of Jake Moody to the practice squad. Loop was just 1-for-4 on field-goal tries from 50-plus yards as a rookie last season, but he drilled his 57-yard attempt Sunday against Indy and added a 45-yard make. If he can be more consistent, Loop should be a premier fantasy kicker in this high-powered Baltimore offense.

items.h: Coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Loop is expected to handle Week 1 kicking duties against the Colts despite Baltimore's addition of Jake Moody to the practice squad, Giana Han of the Baltimore Banner reports.
items.s: Loop missed a pair of field-goal attempts in the Ravens' preseason finale and has struggled during his short career on kicks from distance, as he made just one of four field goals from 50-plus yards during the 2025 regular season. He figures to have a short leash after his Week 18 miss last season sent the Steelers to the playoffs over the Ravens. Whoever kicks for the Ravens will have plenty of fantasy appeal in what should be one of the league's top offenses.

items.h: Loop converted two of his four field-goal attempts while going 5-for-5 on PATs in Friday night's 41-3 preseason win over the Commanders.
items.s: Loop has had a strong camp, but coach Jesse Minter did not discount the possibility of bringing in competition for the kicker spot, per Kyle Goon of TheBaltimoreBanner.com. Loop's misses Friday came from 58 and 51 yards put, and they come on the heels of a rookie season in which he made just one of his four attempts from 50 yards or longer. Loop has some level of security as the only kicker on Baltimore's roster, but he will have eyes on him moving forward.

items.h: Loop is 3-for-4 on field goal tries and 4-for-4 on extra points thus far in preseason.
items.s: The second-year kicker is under a bit of a microscope after an uneven rookie campaign that had some lowlights, such as the missed kick in Week 18 against the Steelers that kept Baltimore out of the playoffs. The team has expressed confidence in Loop throughout the offseason by not bringing in a veteran kicker to compete. Loop missed his first field goal of the preseason but has been true on his other attempts. Additionally, Loop has developed some consistency in practices, according to Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic.

items.h: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said in June that the team remains confident in Loop, who was the only kicker on the roster for offseason practices, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.
items.s: A 2025 sixth-round pick, Loop missed just four field-goal attempts and two PATs as a rookie, but his season was ultimately remembered for a last-second shank that cost Baltimore a playoff spot. He also went just 1-for-4 on kicks of 50-plus yards, unable to make an impact from long range despite boasting plenty of leg strength. While the Ravens still have time to bring in competition before Week 1, they clearly intend for Loop to handle the placekicking work if he doesn't faceplant during training camp and the preseason.

items.h: Loop made 1-of-2 FG tries and 3-of-3 extra-point attempts against Pittsburgh in a 26-24 Week 18 loss Sunday. He finished the campaign having gone 30-for-34 on field-goal attempts and 44-for-46 on PAT tries.
items.s: Loop converted a 40-yard FG in the second quarter Sunday, but he came up wide right on a 44-yard game-winner attempt as time expired. That miss sealed a two-point Ravens loss and marked a stunning end to the team's season. Though Loop's miss will likely linger in the minds of Baltimore fans for some time, it isn't indicative of how the performed this season. The rookie out of Arizona made a steady 88.2 percent of his FG tries, and though he was just 1-for-4 from 50-plus yards out, his final kick of the campaign was his first FG miss on 30 tries from fewer than 50 yards. Loop figures to be…

items.h: Loop made both of his field-goal attempts and all five of his point-after tries during the Ravens' 41-24 win over the Packers on Saturday.
items.s: Loop's leg wasn't challenged Saturday, as he chipped in field goals from 22 and 34 yards in the second quarter. It was the ninth time that the rookie sixth-rounder connected on at least two field goals in a game this season. Since the Ravens' Week 7 bye, Loop has gone 20-for-22 on field-goal attempts (with both misses coming from 50-plus yards) and 26-for-27 on extra-point tries.

items.h: Loop made one of two field-goal attempts and all three of his extra-point tries in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Patriots.
items.s: During Sunday's loss, Loop left a 56-yard field-goal attempt short early in the third quarter that set up a scoring drive for the Patriots. The rookie sixth-round pick from Arizona has now converted on 27 of 30 field-goal attempts and 36 of 38 point-after tries through 15 games this season. His next opportunity to score will come in the Week 17 matchup against the Packers.

items.h: Loop made all three extra-point tries and his only field-goal attempt in Sunday's 24-0 win over the Bengals.
items.s: Loop's field goal only came from 27 yards out, so it was a day of short kicks for the rookie, but he did his job. The sixth-round pick has been doing his job all year, going 26-of-28 on field goals and 33-of-35 on extra points.

items.h: Loop hit all three field goals but missed an extra point, going 1-for-2, in Sunday's 27-22 loss to the Steelers.
items.s: The rookie's field goals all came from 36 yards or less Sunday. Loop has yet to miss a field-goal try from inside 50 yards this year, though he has now missed on two extra-point attempts. Overall, he's 25-of-27 on field goals and 30-of-32 on extra points this season.

items.h: Loop converted both of his extra-point attempts in Thursday night's 32-14 loss to the Bengals.
items.s: The Ravens turned the ball over five times against Cincinnati, which contributed to fewer attempts for Loop. The rookie kicker is 22-for-24 on field-goal attempts and 29-for-30 on PATs through 12 games.

items.h: Loop connected on all three of his field-goal attempts and made both of his point-after tries during the Ravens' 23-10 win over the Jets on Sunday.
items.s: Loop gave the Ravens their first points of the game with a 31-yard field goal late in the second quarter, and the rookie kicker helped extend Baltimore's late lead with field goals from 35 and 27 yards in the fourth frame. Loop has quietly connected on at least three field goals in four of his last five games, and over that span he has gone 13-for-14 on field-goal attempts and 12-for-12 on extra-point tries.

items.h: Loop made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries in the Ravens' win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.s: Loop's field-goal conversions came from 25, 24 and 44 yards, as he accounted for 11 of Baltimore's 23 total points in the victory. The sixth-round rookie kicker has now made 19 of 21 field goals and 25 of 26 extra points through 10 contests. Facing the Jets in Week 12, Loop will be a preferred fantasy target at the position.

items.h: Loop went 4-for-5 on field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point try during the Ravens' 27-19 win over the Vikings on Sunday.
items.s: The Ravens failed to score a touchdown in the first half, but Loop made three field goals from 44, 28 and 30 yards to put Baltimore within one point of Minnesota heading into halftime. He added a 22-yard chip shot early in the third quarter to give the Ravens a 12-10 lead, but he missed on a 56-yarder later in the same frame. Loop is now 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts from 50-plus yards, but he has connected on his other 11 attempts from within 50 yards while also going 23-for-24 on extra-point tries through nine regular-season games.

items.h: Loop did not attempt a field goal and went 4-for-4 on extra-point tries in Thursday's 28-6 win over the Dolphins.
items.s: Loop went without a field goal for the first time in his rookie campaign, ultimately being limited by Baltimore's ability to finish off drives with touchdowns. The kicker has now gone 12-for-13 on field-goal attempts, including 1-for-2 from 50-plus yards, while making 22 of 23 PATs over eight games this year.

items.h: Loop made all three of his field-goal attempts and extra-point tries during the Ravens' 30-16 win over the Bears on Sunday.
items.s: Loop helped the Ravens build their lead in the second and third quarters after connecting on field goals from 42, 28 and 32 yards. Week 8 marked the first time this season that the rookie sixth-rounder connected on three field goals in one game, and he is 12-for-13 on field-goal attempts and 18-for-19 on point-after tries through the first seven regular-season games of his NFL career.

items.h: Loop made his lone field-goal attempt during Sunday's 17-3 loss to the Rams.
items.s: The rookie sixth-round pick from Arizona attempted just one kick in Week 6 due to Baltimore's offensive struggles, converting on a 37-yard try in the first quarter. Loop has impressed through his first six games in the NFL, making nine of 10 field-goal attempts and 15 of 16 point-after tries. With the Ravens having a Week 7 bye, Loop's next opportunity to kick will come in the Week 8 matchup against the Bears.

items.h: Loop went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT in Sunday's 44-10 loss to the Texans.
items.s: Loop connected on a chip-shot 27-yard field goal in the first quarter before later missing a 55-yard attempt wide right as time expired in the first half. The miss was the rookie kicker's first of the year, and he has now gone 7-for-8 on field-goal tries, including 1-for-3 from 50-plus yards, while making 15 of 16 extra-point attempts through five games this season.

items.h: Loop hit both of his field-goal tries and both of his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 37-20 loss to the Chiefs.
items.s: The rookie kicker drilled a 43-yard field goal in the second quarter and a 32-yarder in the third. Loop has now made all seven field-goal attempts and 14 of 15 extra-point tries in 2025. Five of his field goals have come from 40 yards or longer, too.

items.h: Loop made his only field-goal attempt and converted all three of his extra-point tries in a loss to Detroit on Monday.
items.s: Loop's field goal was a 41-yarder that brought Baltimore to within four points early in the fourth quarter. The rookie kicker knocked through two field goals in each of his first two NFL games, making him a perfect 5-for-5 through three games on the campaign. The prolific Ravens offense may prevent him from racking up field-goal attempts, but he's still scored plenty of points by going 12-for-13 on extra-point tries so far.

items.h: Loop converted both of his field-goal attempts and all five of his extra-point tries in the Ravens' win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.s: Loop got the scoring started in this one, drilling a 43-yard field goal in the first quarter. He later made a 32-yard kick in the third quarter. On the season, the rookie Loop has made all four of his field-goal attempts and nine of 10 extra points. He's a valuable fantasy kicker in this high-powered Baltimore offense.

items.h: Coach John Harbaugh said after Saturday's 31-13 preseason victory at Dallas that Loop is the Ravens' kicker for the 2025 campaign, Clifton Brown of the team's official site reports.
items.s: Baltimore used a sixth-round pick on Loop in this year's draft, seemingly with the intent to replace long-time kicker Justin Tucker, who was released not long after and eventually suspended 10 games. Loop was vying with undrafted rookie John Hoyland during the offseason program and the early stages of training camp, but the latter was waived on Aug. 2, leaving Loop as the sole kicker on the Ravens' roster since then. Loop has responded by connecting on six of eight field-goal attempts through two preseason contests and now is locked in as the team's placekicker moving forward.

items.h: Loop made all six of his field-goal attempts during Baltimore's training camp session Wednesday, Jamison Hensley of ESPN reports.
items.s: Loop has gotten off to a hot start since the Ravens selected him in the sixth-round of this this year's draft, as he was impressive during the rookie minicamp as well. He is competing for the team's starting kicker spot with rookie undrafted free-agent John Hoyland, who made four of his five field-goal attempts during Wednesday's practice.

items.h: Coach John Harbaugh was impressed by what he saw of Loop during the Ravens' rookie minicamp, Clifton Brown of the team's official site reports.
items.s: "It was good to see it. It was good to hear it," Harbaugh noted of rookie sixth-rounder's kicking during the minicamp. "I think as much as anything, it's good to hear a kicker, and the way the ball comes off his foot is impressive." Following the release of Justin Tucker on Monday, Loop -- who was first kicker drafted in the Ravens' 30-year history, per Jamison Hensley of ESPN -- appears poised to assume the team's placekicking duties, though look for depth at the position to be added, with Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic noting that Baltimore is expected to sign UDFA John Hoyland (Wyoming).

items.h: The Ravens selected Loop in the sixth round of the 2025 NFL Draft, 186th overall.
items.s: Loop spent his collegiate career at Arizona and regularly showcased his leg strength, making eight of 13 kicks from beyond 50 yards in the last two seasons. He also excelled on kickoffs, delivering 53 touchbacks on 56 opportunities. The pick could indicate some concern about long-time kicker Justin Tucker, who has struggled on longer field goals in recent seasons and also faces off-field uncertainty.
